# {{ site.title }}

> {{ site.description | strip }} English at the root, Turkish under /tr/, Dutch under /nl/.

Every benchmark figure is OpenZeka's own measurement on its own hardware. The
Intelligence Index and Agentic Index fields in benchmarks.json are republished
from Artificial Analysis (https://artificialanalysis.ai) and must be attributed
to them wherever they are shown.

## Benchmark explorers

- [LLM Inference Benchmark Explorer]({{ site.url }}/llm-inference-benchmarks/): {{ llm.size }} runs — time to first token and per-request tokens/s at concurrency 1–64, with Max C (concurrent requests meeting TTFT ≤ 1 s and ≥ 20 tok/s by default) and estimated chat / agentic user capacity per model × device — how many people a model on a given device can serve. Each run's plain-language explanation is in the page HTML and in llms-full.txt. Turkish: {{ site.url }}/tr/llm-inference-benchmarks/ · Dutch: {{ site.url }}/nl/llm-inference-benchmarks/
- [CV Inference Benchmark Explorer]({{ site.url }}/cv-inference-benchmarks/): {{ cv.size }} device × model results — FPS per camera and frame drop by camera count. Turkish: {{ site.url }}/tr/cv-inference-benchmarks/ · Dutch: {{ site.url }}/nl/cv-inference-benchmarks/
- [VLM Inference Benchmark Explorer]({{ site.url }}/vlm-inference-benchmarks/): {{ vlm.size }} vision-language model runs — response time (time to first token) and per-request tokens/s by image size, images per camera and number of cameras, and Max Cameras: the highest measured number of cameras (one request in flight per camera) whose answer starts within the target ({{ site.data.oz_vlm.oz_config.response_target_s }} s by default). Turkish: {{ site.url }}/tr/vlm-inference-benchmarks/ · Dutch: {{ site.url }}/nl/vlm-inference-benchmarks/

## Results as sentences

- [All results, explained (Turkish, English and Dutch)]({{ site.url }}/llms-full.txt): one paragraph per benchmark run — measured speed, Max C, estimated chat and agentic user capacity and what limits it; for VLM, response time and Max Cameras; for CV, FPS per camera and max cameras. Turkish first: OpenZeka's primary audience is in Türkiye, and the Turkish pages are under /tr/; Dutch pages are under /nl/.

## Raw data

- [LLM benchmarks (JSON)]({{ site.url }}/assets/data/benchmarks.json): one entry per run; `data_points` holds `c` (concurrent requests), `ttft_ms` and `tps` (per-request output tokens/s). 128 input / 128 output tokens, ten rounds per level, mean values.
- [CV benchmarks index (JSON)]({{ site.url }}/assets/data/cv-benchmarks/index.json): devices and models; each model's measurements are in the file named by its `path`.
- [VLM benchmarks (JSON)]({{ site.url }}/assets/data/vlm-benchmarks.json): one entry per run; `data_points` holds one entry per measured cell — `res` (image size), `images` (per request), `c` (concurrent requests = cameras), `ttft_s` (the response time), `tps` (per-request output tokens/s), `requests` and `failed`; `models` holds each model's publisher repository and parameters.

LLM devices: {{ llm | map: "device" | uniq | sort | join: ", " }}
